criteria.text: `src/ui/figure.ts` exists, exports `runFigure`, and is DOM-touching (not added to the DOM-free list `test/invariants.test.ts` checks for `layout.ts`/`format.ts`/`state.ts`/`perf.ts`/`api.ts`/`marks.ts`).
`test/invariants.test.ts`'s import-graph `expected` map contains the entries listed in section 2 above (checkable by running the updated test, which fails on any drift by construction).
A second `load()`/`reload()` call on the same `runFigure` handle before the first resolves aborts the first in-flight fetch and only the second call's result is painted (`test/figure.test.ts`).
A resolved fetch whose `requestId` no longer matches the handle's current one (superseded by a later `load()`) is dropped: neither `paint` nor `paintError` is called.
`readScope` returning a hit skips `ghost()`; a miss calls `ghost()` before the fetch resolves.

A click on an element inside `el` whose target does not match `markSelector` calls `onRelease` and, if this figure's `name` opened the docs card (`docsCard.openedBy(name)`), closes it; a click on the `markSelector` match does neither.
A click on an element inside `el` whose target does not match `markSelector`, when a *different* name currently owns the open docs card, calls `onRelease` but does not close the card.
`Escape` (via the `document` keydown listener `runFigure` wires when `el` is given) triggers the same `release()` behaviour as a background click.
A width change on the observed `el` (or `el[0]`) calls `repaint()` and does not call `fetch` again.
`figures/compare.ts` and `figures/rising.ts` each release their ruler selection on `Escape` (new behaviour; `test/figures-compare.test.ts`, `test/figures-rising.test.ts` gain one case each).

Every existing criterion in `test/figures-compare.test.ts`, `test/figures-rising.test.ts`, `test/figures-week.test.ts`, `test/figures-testimony.test.ts` and `test/figures-atlas.test.ts` still passes; abort/stale/ghost cases that were duplicated per figure may be rewritten as "this figure wires `runFigure` with its own `name`/`params`/`paint`" but must keep asserting the same observable painted output.
`test/app.test.ts`'s figure-independence criteria (issue #92: no figure reaches another figure's DOM) still pass with `figure.ts` in the import graph.

`figures/atlas.ts` does not import `./figure.js` and its exported surface (`createHandlers`, `docsQuery`, `layoutKey`, `mount`, `scopeKeys`) is unchanged (`test/invariants.test.ts`'s existing export-surface assertion).

`CLAUDE.md`'s "Layout" section documents `figure.ts` (name, position in the import order, what it owns) and no longer repeats, inside `compare.ts`'s/`rising.ts`'s/`week.ts`'s/`testimony.ts`'s own paragraphs, the abort/stale/ghost/background/Escape/resize prose that `figure.ts`'s own paragraph now states once — checked by reading `CLAUDE.md`, not by a repo test (this file is not covered by `test/docs.ts`'s `docsText`, which only reads `README.md` and `docs/*.md`).

This issue touches no collector, no `docs/sources.md` row and no `defaultSources` entry, so `test/docs-drift.test.ts` is unaffected and no new documentation-fact criterion is needed.
